    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The hypotheses are a tree with one tab stop; every card says its title, how it stands and, for a split, whether any or all of the ones below cause it
      - listitem: The evidence under the tree is announced politely when it changes
      - listitem: "Status is never color alone: ruled out, confirmed and root cause are words, and ruled-out lines are dashed"
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The hypothesis being checked shimmers; one that's ruled out fades back flat with a dashed line, but stays
      - listitem: The evidence card grows and shrinks with what's in it – short while there's nothing to show, easing to its new height
      - listitem: When the root cause is confirmed, the way up to the failure draws itself in blue, from the cause up, one step after the other
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything simply appears
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Every card has a fixed height, so nothing moves when a hypothesis is checked, ruled out or confirmed; the failure's card fits its own title, the hypotheses all share one width – as wide as their longest title needs, growing into spare room – and a title too long for the room ends in “…”, shown whole in the evidence
      - listitem: The tree lays itself out from its own width; when even the narrowest cards don't fit it becomes an indented list – two rows a card, the gates as chips on the cards
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Add every hypothesis as soon as the agent has it, as open – then move it through checking to ruled-out or confirmed
      - listitem: Never remove a ruled-out hypothesis; it shows what was checked
      - listitem: "A confirmed cause with children is confirmed only when its gate is met: one child for or, all for and"
      - listitem: The blue of the way up is --ui-rctc-path; how far what you didn't pick fades is --ui-rctc-dim
